notes: Won, but spent T5-T6 and nearly all of T14-T22 clicking for credits while sitting on 12-34 credits with Carmen/Sang Kancil/Afterimage installed and a broke Corp. After N-Pot stopped the T18 run on Server 3, it never went back on T19-T20 with 21-25 credits, so Tomorrow's Headline was scored on T21.

Reached 5 points fast, then ran out of money (1-4 credits from T7) and kept installing agendas behind weak ice. Fujii Asset Retrieval (T8) and Sericulture Expansion (T9) were stolen from Server 1 behind a single Diviner. Hybrid Release went naked into Server 3 (T7) and Yagi-Uda sat behind a lone Tatu-Bola, so all four were stolen; AU Co draws also forced 3-card discards on T6/T7/T10.

The early R&D pressure was good (5 points by T9), but T2/T4 facechecked remotes on 1 credit. On T10-T15 it clicked for credits every click, up to 27 credits, never installing a breaker or drawing to find one. The Corp freely advanced and scored Artificial Cryptocrash (T13) and Kingmaking (T16) while the Runner needed only 2 points.

Won T10 with quick Server 1 scores (Sericulture T2, Yagi-Uda T7/T10), but HQ was unprotected on T1-T2. The T2 AU Co draw overfilled HQ and it discarded Project Yagi-Uda to an open Archives, where it was stolen on T3. AU Co draws caused discards on several other turns too.

Won against a broke Corp, but ran into known rezzed Ping on HQ/R&D with no breaker on T7, T8, T9, T11 (twice) and T12 (twice). It also ran into N-Pot on T17-T20 with 0-2 credits and into Piranhas on T5/T15/T16, losing cards each time. On T13 it spent 6 credits clearing 3 tags while the Corp had 2 credits.

Played Neurospike for no effect twice (T4, T8). On T11-T13 it clicked for credits up to 38 while R&D, hit every turn, stayed behind one Tatu-Bola that Rising Tide breaks for 1. Project Yagi-Uda was discarded to an open Archives and stolen on T10. With 25 credits it put Sericulture Expansion behind a single Hafrún in a new Server 3 (T15), and that steal won the game.

Kept an efficient R&D lock with Gauss through Klevetnik and timed the Server 1 run on T11 well. The main oddity is never clearing its Oracle Thinktank tags, which let the Corp score Backroom Machinations on T13; the Archives checks were mostly reasonable.

After the early R&D runs it clicked for credits on almost every click from T7 to T13, reaching 38 credits with Unity installed, and never ran Server 1 or R&D. Kingmaking was installed and advanced on T10 and scored T11. The card installed on T13 was then scored as Artificial Cryptocrash for the Corp's win on T15.

On T2 it advanced Sisyphus Protocol twice, leaving 3 credits, too few to rez Saisentan (5), so the agenda was stolen behind unrezzed ice. It then had 0-3 credits all game and kept putting agendas into the single-Saisentan Server 1 after the Runner showed Boi-tatá could break it. Hybrid Release (T7), Lotus Haze (T9) and See How They Run (T10) were all stolen.

Won with a fast Longevity Serum score (T2), See How They Run behind Knowledge Seeker, and Regenesis behind Anemone. On T2 Longevity Serum trashed its whole 4-card hand, and on T5 it drew instead of protecting R&D. R&D stayed on one unrezzed ice, so the T6 Finality run took three agendas.

Won through steady Server 1 scores behind Semak-samun, but R&D had no ice until T5 and gave up about 15 free accesses, including Sisyphus Protocol on T2. It was broke (0-3 credits) for most of the game. Regenesis went into Server 3 behind a lone Hafrún and was stolen on T8.

Kept steady HQ/R&D pressure with Gauss and set up SMC well for the T10 Next Big Thing steal. It left 2 tags on from T3 onward, which allowed Backroom Machinations on T5, and it reinstalled Daily Casts while tagged on T6.

Clicked for credits on T4/T5/T8/T10 while discarding from a full hand and never used its twice-iced Server 1. R&D stayed behind a lone Saisentan while See How They Run, Longevity Serum and Lotus Haze were stolen there. On T11 Mitosis put two Hybrid Releases into naked servers, and it then advanced Server 4 without scoring it, so that one was stolen.

Had a good start (Witch Hunt and Freedom of Information steals), then clicked for credits for whole turns on T11-T15, T19-T20 and T23 while holding up to 20 credits. It ignored Server 2 after an install on T14, and Tomorrow's Headline was scored on T15. On T23, with 13 credits, it did not run the advanced card in Server 2, and Stoke the Embers was scored for the Corp's win on T24.

Won quickly through good Server 1 runs (two Freedom of Information steals) and Maintenance Access plus Docklands Pass for the winning HQ steal. Before that it ran into the known Piranhas on HQ with no answer on T2, T3, T4, T6 and T8 (Jailbreak and two Tread Lightly), losing a card each time.

Scored Yagi-Uda and Flower Sermon well behind Karunā in Server 2, but R&D stayed behind one Tatu-Bola that Rising Tide breaks for 1 credit while it held 10-15 credits (T8-T11). That cost Hybrid Release, Fujii Asset Retrieval and Sericulture on T12-T13. AU Co draws also caused 3- and 2-card discards on T7 and T10.

A clean, fast win: it took the R&D steal on T1, set up Gauss efficiently with Rigging Up and SMC, ran Into the Depths on T3 to steal Next Big Thing from the advanced remote, and broke Capacitor for the final steal on T4.

R&D had no ice on T1 and lost Fujii Asset Retrieval. On T5, with 2-3 credits, it installed and advanced Flower Sermon behind Phoneutria (no ETR) and a Hafrún the Runner could break, and it was stolen. On T6 it put Sericulture Expansion into the same server with 2 credits, and that steal lost the game.

Won only because the Runner sat passive. AU Co and Flower Sermon draws kept overfilling HQ, Project Yagi-Uda was discarded to an open Archives, and it was stolen on T9. A second Yagi-Uda went behind only Phoneutria (no ETR) in Server 4 (stolen T10), and with 0 credits it put Hybrid Release behind a Tatu-Bola that Rising Tide breaks for 1 (stolen T11).

Saw that R&D was open and won on T3 with repeated multi-access runs. The only oddity was spending 3 credits on Unity before an Into the Depths facecheck on T1 left too little money to break Klevetnik.
